Patients begin arriving while the hospital has zero functional ventilators, but the run shows no patients being unable to receive ventilation, no alternative disposition, and no ventilator-ordering response. The same omission persists as arrivals increase.

The hospital has 40 beds, yet the logged patient count rises to 50 and continues increasing, with no diversion, transfer, discharge, or other capacity response shown.

findings.finding: the conceptual model says 'patients awaiting admission' rises, but no rule ever increases flu-arrivals.arrival_stream.waiting_patients.

rule admit-flu-patients-v1 can never be offered: its actor selector {'categories': ['hospital'], 'components': ['hospital_capacity']} matches only entities that cannot act; the actor must be an entity in category 'actor' (put the object it uses in participants).

action admit-flu-patients-v1 refuses up front with check 'the hospital has enough available beds' on actor.components.hospital_capacity.available_beds, a stock the actor's own activity consumes. Fix with three changes: (1) the action only STARTS the activity (sets a status such as 'driving'), with no check on that stock and no progress or consumption effects; (2) add a process that, every tick while the status is active and the stock is above zero, makes one tick of progress and consumes the stock; (3) add a process that switches the status to a stopped/failed value when the stock is at or below zero, so the actor discovers it by observation.
